controls.title: Endpoint and execution isolation
controls.implementation: No model tools; hard legacy hold; credential-free CI; local sandbox policy

controls.title: Software supply chain
controls.implementation: Pinned inventory, lock integrity, script-disabled installation, npm audit/signatures and SBOM

controls.title: Trusted AI registry
controls.implementation: Deny-by-default registry, measured artifact bytes and capability checks
releaseEvidence: Runtime skill/MCP broker before enabling any

controls.title: Identity and permission broker
controls.implementation: Explicit actor, tenant, project, role, evidence revision and independent review checks
releaseEvidence: Role revocation and cross-tenant browser/API tests

controls.title: AI firewall and DLP
controls.implementation: Bounded normalized text and structured payload heuristic inspection; synthetic/public policy only

controls.title: Mandatory GC-05 integration
controls.implementation: Synthetic controlled review reserves once and debits every call; old AI routes hard-held
releaseEvidence: Live staging quota and provider acceptance

controls.title: Atomic persistence and audit
controls.implementation: Staging SQL candidate locks records, validates citations and obligations, creates Under Review candidate atomically

controls.title: Security observability and incident response
controls.implementation: Metadata-only events, restricted append RPC, stop control and incident playbook

controls.title: AI red-team acceptance
controls.implementation: Automated synthetic attacks for isolation, injection, data loss, tool misuse and approval bypass

controls.title: AI security competency
controls.implementation: Competency curriculum, assessment, incident reporting and named-role charter
